title: Add session ID display to loop TUI header
description: Show the current sessionId (truncated to 8 characters) in the loop TUI header so users can correlate history files with loop sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: TUI header shows a session ID (8 chars)
Session ID matches the prefix of history files created during the session

steps.details: Generate the sessionId in loop.ts before rendering: const sessionId = Date.now().toString(). Pass as prop to RocketLoopApp: <RocketLoopApp ... sessionId={sessionId} />
Update the header in RocketLoopApp to include: <Text dimColor> | Session: {sessionId.slice(0, 8)}</Text>
